Things to know
Data shared between Gemini and Connected Apps includes things like your
saved data from Search services and YouTube, emails, files, events, photos,
videos, info about your contacts (such as phone numbers, addresses and
birthdays) and location info (from your IP address, device, saved history and
content), as well as insights drawn from them. Data shared may relate to topics
that you find sensitive.
